transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Synergex Medical Group, this is Maria. How can I help you today?
Caller: Hi Maria, I need to schedule an appointment with Dr. Peterson for my annual checkup.
Agent: Of course! I'd be happy to help you get that scheduled. Can I get your name and date of birth to pull up your account?
Caller: Sure, it's David Chen, and my birthday is March 15th.
Agent: Thank you, David. I can see your account here. Dr. Peterson has availability on Thursday April 10th at 2:00 PM and Friday April 11th at 10:30 AM. Do either of those work for you?
Caller: Thursday at 2 PM works great.
Agent: Perfect! I've got you scheduled for Thursday, April 10th at 2:00 PM with Dr. Peterson at our Riverside clinic location. You'll need to arrive about 15 minutes early to complete any updated paperwork. Is the Riverside location convenient for you?
Caller: Yes, that's perfect, it's close to my office.
Agent: Wonderful. You'll receive a confirmation text and email within the next few minutes. We also send a reminder 48 hours before the appointment. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Caller: No, that's everything. Thank you so much!
Agent: My pleasure, David! We look forward to seeing you on April 10th. Have a great rest of your day!
Caller: You too, bye!
